name: chown
purpose: Change Owner — transfer ownership of a file or directory to another user.
explanation: Changes the owner of a file so another user can own or manage it safely.
whenToUse: When another user needs to own or manage a file.
commonMistakes: Confusing chown (changes owner) with chmod (changes read/write/execute permissions).
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `chown` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: zsh: command not found: chown (if not installed or missing from PATH)

beforeAfterState.before: Filesystem/permissions are in their initial state prior to command execution.
beforeAfterState.after: Target file or directory state is updated by `chown` as specified.
